environment: Existing staging testnet, APAC Gateway, local Chromium
comparison: named wallet object IDs; stored unique wallet object IDs; named wallet object IDs repeated
limitations: Three new wallets per arm. Worker and Durable Object cold state is unproven.
SDK payload and placement configuration stayed fixed. Physical colocation is unproven.
Only NEAR signing was enabled. The NEAR signer worker loaded and no ECDSA signer worker loaded. Shared JavaScript and custody code can contain both protocols.
Implicit account registration and NEP-413 signing exclude funding and blockchain confirmation.
Browser timing includes automation. SDK timing and interaction timing are recorded separately.
No full D1 trace was captured. The added address lookup is included in end-to-end elapsed time, but its separate cost is not measured.
Sequential baseline, candidate and control samples do not establish a latency guarantee.
